title: MitoQ Supplementation for Microvascular Health and Stroke Recovery
official: MitoQ Supplementation for Microvascular Health and Stroke Recovery
summary: Stroke survivors have compromised vascular function which may contribute to secondary stroke risk, cardiovascular disease, and may limit their exercise tolerance. Preliminary data shows an antioxidant supplement called MitoQ may improve vascular function and muscle activity in individuals post-stroke.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18-85 years
* Cortical or subcortical stroke ≥ 6 months ago
* Follows 2-step command
* English speaking

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to walk 10 meters without physical assistance (able to use assistive device)
* Unable to perform HIIE
* Head Trauma \< 6 months ago
* Resting BP ≥ 180/100 mmHg
* Heart attack \<1 year ago.
* Pregnant and/or breastfeeding
* History of other neurological disease
* Unable to obtain MCAv signal
* Other significant medical condition likely to influence study or jeopardize safety as assessed by Primary Investigator
